title: Single-use Bureau runtime refresh successor for Heim-PC NixOS migration visibility
goal: Publish exactly one initially non-executable planned Bureau runtime-refresh successor through a protected one-file PR, adopt it missing-only into authoritative StateStore, and only then activate it by a proof-bearing planned-to-ready CAS. Its sole purpose is to converge the installed Bureau runtime and canonical Registry from fd9570bbc99719f601879482def202b23bddbf01 to a freshly observed protected-main successor so the already merged and StateStore-adopted HEIM-PC-NIXOS-MIGRATION-V1 becomes visible to the installed control plane. It succeeds the effect-started but exactly rolled-back PR #2249 authority attempt c0ec155d4264b9955951b8cff5c38c246dd83b972c20fd91166f5431b99dd72d and never reuses that authority or intent. This authority performs no NixOS migration work itself.

approval.note: Single-use target-bound successor only for Bureau runtime/Registry convergence required by the direct user continuation of HEIM-PC-NIXOS-MIGRATION-V1. PR #2249 authority attempt c0ec155d4264b9955951b8cff5c38c246dd83b972c20fd91166f5431b99dd72d began an effect and then restored the exact scheduler preimage after bureau-task-supply.service was already failed because the installed fd9570 Registry cannot resolve the adopted HEIM-PC-NIXOS-MIGRATION-V1 initiative; its result 1302d25bb6a8c69e99e2cc2db6760c509a915f4b2081d6a8172bec34ff0b1179 is safe_to_retry=false. This new authority is independent and single-use and never reuses that predecessor authority or intent. Any scheduler-service state remediation needed before the reserved executor start is outside this authority and must be separately typed, receipt-bound, and read back; this authority neither authorizes nor attests that remediation. No NixOS production effect and no blind retry.

acceptance.assertion: Immediately before prepare-intent and again before apply, heimgewebe/bureau main is freshly observed. The exact target contains the protected merge of HEIM-PC-NIXOS-MIGRATION-V1 PR #2237, the executor-compatible PR #2249 successor contract, this authority publication, and all legitimate intermediate protected-main merges; validate (3.10), validate (3.12), and registry-registration-preflight/freshness are successful for the exact target context. Any main, PR, check, target, source/manifest, or authority drift invalidates older observations and intents.

Before prepare-intent and again before apply, deployment-manifest source and canonical Registry source are identity-valid and equal. The active source is exactly fd9570bbc99719f601879482def202b23bddbf01 or a later mutually identical source and is freshly proven as a Git ancestor of the selected protected-main target. Mismatch, divergence, unavailable ancestry proof, or target drift blocks fail-closed.

Before any runtime effect, authoritative StateStore exposes this exact task ID on a proof-bearing ready revision later than the initial missing-only adopted planned revision. That revision binds metadata.protected_publication_adoption to the real publication PR and merge commit and atomically adds the protected-publication-and-missing-only-adoption acceptance plus no-run evidence binding.

This authority starts at most one Bureau runtime effect. It is a fresh successor to the distinct PR #2249 authority whose c0ec155d4264b9955951b8cff5c38c246dd83b972c20fd91166f5431b99dd72d attempt already began an effect and rolled back; that predecessor is never retried or substituted here. Failed, unclear, timeout, or transport-ambiguous outcomes of this authority are reconstructed from intent, attempt/result, manifest, launcher, Registry, task lifecycle, and authority-consumption evidence before any further action; no blind retry is permitted.

After successful apply, deployment manifest, immutable release, package tree, launchers, scheduler artifacts, and canonical Registry snapshot bind the same freshly observed source commit; StateStore integrity and Bureau runtime identity are valid, and the installed default Bureau frontier can resolve HEIM-PC-NIXOS-MIGRATION-V1 with only T001 and T002 ready while T003 through T011 remain planned.

The authority is consumed at most once and grants only the Bureau runtime/Registry convergence required to make the already merged and StateStore-adopted HEIM-PC-NIXOS-MIGRATION-V1 live-visible. It does not authorize or attest scheduler-service state remediation; any such operator prerequisite must be separately authorized, receipt-bound, and read back before intent preparation. It grants no NixOS production mutation, storage/EFI/firmware/reboot effect, migration task claim or dispatch, queue/task-supply execution, unrelated repository mutation, or foreign-work authority.

rollback.strategy: The currently integrity-valid deployed Bureau runtime at fd9570bbc99719f601879482def202b23bddbf01 remains authoritative until a new immutable result is fully read back. PR #2249 attempt c0ec155d4264b9955951b8cff5c38c246dd83b972c20fd91166f5431b99dd72d already demonstrated exact rollback from an effect-started scheduler failure and is never retried. If this successor publication/adoption, source ancestry, target freshness, CI, StateStore binding, execution-context writability, lease binding, or runtime effect becomes unclear, preserve all evidence and do not retry; reconciliation requires another separately authorized successor path.

metadata.source: HEIM-PC-NIXOS-MIGRATION-V1 is merged in Bureau PR #2237 and adopted authoritatively into StateStore, while the installed Bureau runtime/canonical Registry remains at fd9570bbc99719f601879482def202b23bddbf01. Fresh observation 9353db51b87167d07810f5d0958f2bc6f6d92b5747c70a030e4aa19e81fca9dc proved fd9570 is an ancestor of protected main fbcd669ce06ceb0f70e3b449d65f020d120d5160 with required checks green. The generic executor-compatible PR #2249 authority was then target-bound and attempted once under intent c0ec155d4264b9955951b8cff5c38c246dd83b972c20fd91166f5431b99dd72d; it began an effect, failed only because the pre-existing bureau-task-supply.service result was failed from the stale Registry unknown-initiative condition, restored the exact scheduler preimage, and returned safe_to_retry=false. This TaskSpec is a new successor authority, not a retry.

publication_path.post_adoption_activation: exact proof-bearing StateStore CAS to ready after the real protected publication PR and merge commit are observed
publication_path.reason: Installed Bureau runtime/Registry predates the already merged/adopted HEIM-PC-NIXOS-MIGRATION-V1. PR #2249 supplied a valid executor-compatible generic authority, but its one effect-started attempt was exactly rolled back because the required bureau-task-supply.service carried a pre-existing failed result caused by that same stale Registry. The predecessor result is safe_to_retry=false, so a distinct purpose-bound successor authority is required. Any scheduler-service state remediation needed before execution is a separate typed operator prerequisite and is not authorized or attested by this TaskSpec.
does_not_establish: queue, claim, dispatch or task-supply authority

metadata.post_refresh_live_target: Read back exact Bureau runtime/Registry convergence and default installed frontier visibility of HEIM-PC-NIXOS-MIGRATION-V1; leave T001/T002 ready and T003-T011 planned. No migration task execution in this authority.

post_publication_activation.required_contract: Activation candidate MUST add metadata.protected_publication_adoption and a matching protected-publication-and-missing-only-adoption acceptance criterion plus no-run required_evidence=[protected-publication-adoption] in the same validated CAS that changes planned to ready.
post_publication_activation.required_no_run_evidence: Activation candidate adds protected-publication-adoption together with its typed contract; the planned bootstrap declares neither half of that pair.

adopt-authority has seeded exactly the publication TaskSpec as planned using missing-only legacy-seed-exact semantics
current StateStore revision/digest still equal the adoption receipt

construct one activated candidate from that exact revision which adds metadata.protected_publication_adoption, adds protected-publication-and-missing-only-adoption to acceptance, adds the matching no-run protected-publication-adoption evidence requirement, and changes state planned to ready
validate the activated candidate with the installed runtime authority validator and no-run acceptance validator before CAS
prove protected publication/adoption against the real PR/merge and exact missing-only receipt before CAS
CAS only from the exact adopted revision/digest; after CAS repeat authoritative StateStore readback and protected-publication/adoption proof before prepare-intent
